deferred_requirements.title: Schema-level construction payload provenance
deferred_requirements.fact: Current Strategy Spec, Variant Manifest, and Sweep Plan schemas use additionalProperties=false and do not define exact construction_payload/non_promotable eligibility fields.
deferred_requirements.decision: Do not create scratch schema artifacts in this package.
deferred_requirements.needed_later: Add an explicitly authorized schema or fixture-artifact surface that can carry permanent construction_payload, non_promotable, candidate_eligible=false, promotion_eligible=false, paper_live_eligible=false, edge_claim_allowed=false, and canonical_crossing_allowed=false semantics.

deferred_requirements.title: Downstream hard rejection implementation
deferred_requirements.fact: This package defines contracts only and changes no gates, crossing code, dashboard code, lab state code, agent code, runner code, schemas, or validators.
deferred_requirements.decision: Later consumer packages must implement or validate rejection behavior separately.
deferred_requirements.needed_later: Gate, agent-loop, dashboard/reporting, and crossing guard packages must prove these payloads cannot become candidates or crossing inputs.
